notes: Review fixes: the durable watermark is now recoveredThrough (recovery progress only, never live sends); thread/DM keys are pruned on save; outcome.advancedTo drives durable progress so skip-heavy gaps cross the page bound; per-message send attempts are bounded with backoff and a gateway.status probe separates a poison message (skipped forward) from an outage; failed/truncated passes schedule a backoff retry; the truncated log no longer claims an unchanged cursor advanced; an unreadable cursor store fails recovery closed and is exposed via cursorFault. Each fix has a regression test in packages/adapter-discord/test/recovery.test.ts verified to fail when the fix is reverted. The full package run emits an expected session-rebind startup-failure diagnostic from its existing test scenario; the suite completed with zero failing tests.
